observations: Photos show a car engine/engine assembly removed from a vehicle (exposed intake/engine bay components, wiring harness, hoses).
Engine appears to be a Porsche-style flat/boxer layout (cylinders/heads visible on both sides) with a large intake/airbox cover and multiple sensors/connectors.
There is heavy grime/dust and some visible wear on external surfaces; no clear evidence of recent rebuild in the photos.
No readable model/part number plate is visible in the provided angles.
Seller text says they deal in car spare parts, but the photos specifically show an engine assembly, not a generic parts listing.

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller’s text only; photos show an engine assembly, not a parts catalog or proof of inventory.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model (and therefore compatibility and market value) is not readable from the photos.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification/serial plate and any stamped part numbers (and the full engine label area).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine assembly (worst-case: wrong fit/unknown spec), with no premium for brand/model.

risks.risk: Unknown condition (running status, compression/health, internal damage). Photos only show the exterior after removal.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running (or a test/diagnostic report showing compression/leak-down and fault codes), plus a short cold-start clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assumed not working or needing overhaul (worst-case), since no functional proof is shown.

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete assembly (some sensors, brackets, covers, or ancillary parts may be absent).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: underside and both sides showing all connectors, mounts, and accessories; include a photo of everything included laid out (or a receipt/inventory list).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case), assuming buyer may need to source missing parts.

risks.risk: Potential oil/coolant leaks or water damage not visible externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of suspected leak points (seals/gaskets), plus a pressure test or leak test result if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible leaks/needs reseal (worst-case), not as a clean ready-to-install unit.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling risk: engine may be damaged during removal/transport (mounts, housings, wiring harness).
risks.proof: Photos of all mounting points and any cracks/chips; confirm packaging method and whether it will be shipped with proper bracing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged externally (worst-case) until inspection on arrival.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine ID/serial plate and any stamped part numbers (so the exact model can be confirmed).
Video proof of the engine running (or a diagnostic/compression/leak-down report).
Photos showing completeness: all sensors/connectors, mounts, and accessories; plus what exactly is included.
Close-ups of any cracks/major wear points and leak-prone areas (gaskets/seals).
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the exact make/model and working condition cannot be confirmed from the images provided. Without engine identification and proof of functionality/completeness, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
